title: A simple, efficient, and reliable endoderm differentiation protocol for human embryonic stem cells using crotonate
protocol: Quickly thaw a vial of frozen mel1 or H9 cells by gently swirling the vial in a 37°C water bath.
Transfer cells to a 15 mL conical tube and add 5 mL DMEM/F-12 medium drop by drop.
Gently mix the cells.
Centrifuge at 300 × g for 3 min at 20°C–25°C.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend cells in 5 mL DMEM/F-12 medium.
Centrifuge again at 20°C–25°C at 300 × g for 3 min.
Remove the supernatant and resuspend cells with 2 mL TeSR-E8 medium containing 10 μM Y-27632, prewarmed to 37°C.
Aspirate the medium from Matrigel-coated 6-well plates.
Seed 4×10^5 mel1 or H9 cells into them.
Quickly shake the plate in short side-to-side and back-and-forth motions to evenly distribute the cells.
Place the plate in a 37°C incubator with 5% CO2.
Replace Y-27632 containing TeSRTM-E8TM medium with 2 mL fresh warm Y-27632 free TeSRTM-E8TM medium after 24 hours.
Change medium daily.
Increase TeSRTM-E8TM medium to 3–4 mL per well when cells reach above 50% confluency.
Aspirate TeSRTM-E8TM medium from cells when they reach 70–80% confluency.
Add 2 mL warm 0.5 mM EDTA in DPBS to the cells and incubate at 37°C for 10 minutes.
Remove EDTA when cells are dissociated but still attached to plates.
Flush the surface of the wells with 1 mL prewarmed TeSRTM-E8TM containing 10 μM Y-27632.
Mix cell suspension with equal volume of 2 × freezing medium (20% DMSO, 60% embryonic stem-cell FBS, 20% TeSRTM-E8TM medium with Y-27632).
Aliquot the cell suspension from 1 well of a 6-well plate to 5 cryogenic vials.
Freeze the vials at −80°C for 18–24 hours in a 2-propanol-filled freezing container.
Transfer cells to a N2 tank for long-term storage.
Count mel1 cells and seed 3.5–4 × 10^4 cells per well (0.92–1.05 × 10^4 cells/cm²) into a new Matrigel-coated well of a 12-well plate.
Grow cells at a 37°C incubator with 5% CO2.
Remove TesRTM-E8TM medium on the next day.
Wash cells with DPBS once.
Thaw endoderm differentiation medium and store at 4°C.
Add prewarmed 1 mL (0.26 mL/cm²) endoderm differentiation medium from STEMDIFF trilineage differentiation kit.
Add crotonate to a final concentration of 5 mM.
Gently move the plates to mix the medium.
Incubate plates at 37°C with 5% CO₂.
Change endoderm differentiation medium containing crotonate daily for 2 days.
Count H9 cells.
Seed 20.0 × 10^4 cells per well into a new Matrigel-coated well of a 6-well plate with prewarmed TeSR-E8 medium containing 10 μM Y-27632.
Shake the plate to evenly distribute the cells in the well.
Incubate the plate in a 37°C incubator with 5% CO2 for 24 hours.
Aspirate old medium from the wells after 24 hours.
Replace aspirated medium with 2 mL of new and warm TeSR-E8 medium.
Wash cells with 2 mL of warm RPMI 1640 medium on Day 0.
Add 1.8 mL of RACC endoderm differentiation medium to each well.
Grow the cells in a 37°C incubator with 5% CO2 after adding RACC medium.
Replace old medium with 1.8 mL of new endoderm differentiation medium after 24 hours.
Collect samples after another 24 hours.
Examine the expression of key endoderm markers like SOX17, FOXA2, and CXCR4 by qPCR and flow cytometry.
Take out endoderm cells differentiated on Matrigel-coated coverslips for immunofluorescence analysis.
Aspirate medium from the endoderm cells.
Wash the coverslip with DPBS once.
Fix cells with 4% paraformaldehyde in DPBS at 20°C–25°C for 10 minutes.
Permeabilize cells with 0.5% Triton X-100 in DPBS at 20°C–25°C for 10 min.
Wash cells with DPBS once.
Dilute anti-SOX17 antibody (1:200) and anti-FOXA2 antibody (1:200) in DPBS containing 10% FBS.
Spot 50 μL of the antibody solution for each coverslip on a clean parafilm.
Place a coverslip on the 50 μL antibody solution with cells facing down for 1 h at 20°C–25°C.
Float each coverslip with a drop of DPBS and transfer to a 12-well plate.
Wash coverslips with DPBS for 4–5 times.
Make secondary antibody solutions: dilute donkey anti-goat IgG (Alex Fluor 594) at 1:500 and donkey anti-rabbit IgG (Alex Fluor 488) at 1:500 in DPBS containing 10% FBS.
Spot 50 μL of the secondary antibody solution for each coverslip on a clean parafilm.
Place a coverslip on the 50 μL antibody solution with cells facing down for 30 min at 20°C–25°C.
Float each coverslip with a drop of DPBS and transfer to a 12-well plate.
Wash coverslips with DPBS for 4–5 times.
Mount coverslips on slides with antifade mounting medium containing DAPI.
Observe under fluorescence microscopy.
Remove differentiation medium from plates.
Add 1 mL Accutase to cells and incubate at 37°C for 1–2 min.
Remove Accutase.
Add 1 mL DPBS to flush the cells off the surface of the plate.
Centrifuge cells at 300 × g for 3 min at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant and resuspend cells with 1 mL DPBS.
Centrifuge cells at 300 × g for 3 min at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 500 μL 4% paraformaldehyde in DPBS.
Incubate at 20°C–25°C for 10 min.
Centrifuge cells at 300 × g for 3 min at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant.
Resuspend cells with 1 mL DPBS.
Centrifuge at 300 × g for 3 min at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 500 μL DPBS containing 0.5% Triton X-100.
Incubate for 10 min at 20°C–25°C.
Centrifuge cells at 2350 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant.
Wash cells once with DPBS containing 10% FBS.
Centrifuge at 2350 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 200 μL DPBS containing 10% FBS, anti-SOX17 (1:200 dilution), and anti-FOXA2 (1:200 dilution) antibodies.
Incubate for 1 h at 20°C–25°C.
Centrifuge cells at 2350 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 0.5–1 mL DPBS containing 10% FBS.
Centrifuge at 2350 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 200 μL DPBS containing 10% FBS, donkey anti-goat IgG (Alex Fluor 594) (1:400 dilution), and donkey anti-rabbit IgG (Alex Fluor 488) (1:400 dilution).
Incubate for 30 min at 20°C–25°C.
Centrifuge cells at 2350 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant.
Wash with DPBS containing 10% FBS once.
Centrifuge and remove the supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 250 μL DPBS containing 5% FBS.
Analyze the cells with a flow cytometer.
Aspirate medium from cells.
Wash cells once with DPBS.
Extract RNA using Qiagen RNeasy mini kit according to the product manual.
Measure RNA concentrations using a nanodrop spectrophotometer.
Use 2 μg total RNA, 2 μL of 10 × RT buffer, 2 μL of 10 × RT random primers, 0.8 μL of 100 mM dNTP, 1 μL of MultiScribeTM reverse transcriptase, and 4.2 μL RNase-free DEPC dH2O to synthesize cDNA.
Mix well and centrifuge for 1 min.
Place the tube in a PCR machine programmed at 25°C for 10 min, then 50°C for 50 min, followed by 85°C for 5 min.
Dilute 20 μL of cDNA reaction 1:20 with DEPC water and mix well.
Pipette 9 μL of diluted cDNA as template to each well for every 20 μL RT-PCR reaction.
Mix 9 μL of diluted cDNA with 10 μL Bio-Rad iQ SYBR Green supermix and 0.6 μL of each primer (10 μM).
Pipette 11 μL of the resulting mixture to the wells containing 9 μL cDNA.
Seal the PCR plate with film.
Centrifuge the sealed PCR plate for 1 min using a mini plate spinner.
Place the PCR plate in a RT-PCR machine starting with a heating step at 95°C for 3 min, then proceed with 39 cycles of 95°C for 10 s, 58°C for 30 s, and 72°C for 30 s.
